name: lynx-simulator-workspace
description: Workspace for the Lynx desktop simulator SDK and app.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator-core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator-core run test && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run test && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run test:cli
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run dev
scripts.start: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @lynx-js/lynx-simulator run start
